None (foundational work)" --label split-child

- src/enrichment/tool_params.rs

- Tool_params enrichment extracts file paths from Write/Edit calls
- Each path is checked against config patterns
- Config write detections are stored in enrichment output

- Unit tests verify detection of config vs. non-config writes

## Dependencies
- Requires Child 1: is_config_path() helper function" --label split-child

bead create --title "Add config_writes field to BehavioralSignals" --description "## Task
Extend the BehavioralSignals struct to include a config_writes array.

- Add config_writes field to src/enrichment/behavioral_signals.rs

- Update serialization/deserialization if needed
- Ensure field is optional (empty array when no writes detected)

## Files to modify
- src/enrichment/behavioral_signals.rs

## Acceptance Criteria
- BehavioralSignals has config_writes: Vec<ConfigWriteEntry> field
- ConfigWriteEntry contains: path (String), timestamp (DateTime), tool_type (String)
- Field serializes correctly to JSON
- Default empty Vec when no config writes detected
- Unit tests verify struct definition and serialization

## Dependencies
- Requires Child 2: config write data available from tool_params" --label split-child

bead create --title "Wire config write data through enrichment pipeline" --description "## Task
Connect config write detection from tool_params to BehavioralSignals output.

## What to do
- Modify enrichment pipeline to pass config write detections
- Populate BehavioralSignals.config_writes from tool_params data
- Ensure timestamps are correctly captured
- Handle tool type annotation (Write vs Edit)

## Files to modify
- src/enrichment/behavioral_signals.rs or enrichment orchestrator

## Acceptance Criteria
- Config write detections from tool_params populate config_writes
- Each entry includes: path, timestamp, tool_type
- Data flows correctly through enrichment pipeline
- Integration tests verify end-to-end flow
- Handles empty detections gracefully

## Dependencies
- Requires Child 3: BehavioralSignals.config_writes field exists" --label split-child

bead create --title "Add configurable patterns to config.toml" --description "## Task
Make config file patterns configurable via config.toml.

## What to do
- Add config_file_patterns section to config.toml
- Parse patterns at startup
- Pass patterns to enrichment modules
- Provide sensible defaults if not configured

## Files to modify
- config.toml (or equivalent config file)
- Config loading code

## Acceptance Criteria
- config.toml has config_file_patterns array with default patterns
- Default patterns include: \"**/*.toml\", \"**/*.yaml\", \"**/*.yml\", \"**/*.json\", \"**/*.ini\", \"**/*.conf\", \"config/**\", \".config/**\"
- Patterns are loaded and passed to enrichment pipeline
- Empty patterns list is handled (falls back to defaults)
- Config reload on changes (optional but nice)

## Dependencies
- Requires Child 4: patterns are consumed by enrichment pipeline" --label split-child
